notes.title: Update Notes for Feb 10th
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/764090/header.jpg?t=1607542432[/img]

Firstly, thank you to all for playing STAR SHREDDERS and leaving your priceless feedback, we really appreciate the support!

We've made some small updates to help balance the experience for players, please find the list below.

Updates:
[list]
[*] Decreased the hitbox of the player, to allow for easier movement.
[*] Balanced the mine placement, some sections were very difficult to get past.
[*] Increased the amount of drones per section for more of a challenge and to have less empty space.
[/list]

Thank you for all the continued plays, It's always a pleasure seeing new entries on the leaderboard! 🤩

notes.title: Bug Fixes + Update
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone

Firstly thank you so much for all the support, criticisms and feedback for STAR SHREDDERS! 

We are working for you now to complete this game and story for you all to experience. 

We are currently working some new content for the game but also some new mediums to showcase the story and the games progress.

Our lead developer has been hard at work, fixing some crucial bugs in the current build so expect some changes to happen but rest assure, it will be for the best! :)

As the Halloween sale is currently on, we have dropped the price for the festive season also so if you want others to help us, please spread the word!

Thank you again and have a rocking Halloween! As a treat, we have thrown in some concept artwork of Clash! 0_0 

Cheers,
Sharkbowl Games
